links.comparator_used: Identical article attributed to a physician author only (also a no-author condition)
links.outcome: Trust in article content and in the recommending physician
links.effect: AI-only attribution vs physician-only: content trust mean 9.43 vs 11.11 (P = .001); physician trust mean 8.93 vs 10.84 (P = .03). Engagement did not differ significantly across conditions.
links.tradeoff: Disclosing AI authorship lowered trust in the content and in the recommending physician, even though the content was identical and clinician-written.
links.quote: AI authorship was associated with reduced trust in patient-facing education despite identical, clinician-written content.

design_hint: disclosure of AI authorship and physician oversight to patients
